summary: This directory manages the core business entities, data structures, and validation rules that define the application's domain model. It serves as the primary source of truth for representing domain-specific data and enforcing structural consistency across the system.
responsibilities: Enforcing validation rules for business objects
Encapsulating core domain state and logic
Ensuring data integrity across service layers
relationships: Domain models provide the structured data format used by services and components throughout the application.
Validation logic ensures that business entities maintain integrity before being processed by application services.
designDecisions: Separation of data definition from persistence logic
Strong typing to guarantee model consistency
